observations: Three photos show a hairdryer and hairstreamer set on a tiled floor.
The main unit is a large, dome-shaped blue and grey plastic hood with a black base and a power cord extending from it.
Attached to the base are two grey plastic arms, each with a black nozzle or attachment point.
One photo (photo 2) shows the back of the unit with a label that appears to say '1000W' and '220V', but the text is blurry and not fully legible.
The unit has a visible power cord and plug, suggesting it is electric.
No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photos, but the interior of the hood is not shown.
The photos are watermarked with 'AYOMAYOWA OLANIKEKUN' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: The photos show a hairdryer and hairstreamer unit with attachments, consistent with the description.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened, works perfectly. Original receipt and warranty available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The unit may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on, with the fan running and steam output, or a close-up of the internal components.

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be damaged or incompatible with Nigerian outlets.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the plug and cord, showing no fraying or damage, and confirming it is 220V as labeled.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially incompatible or unsafe

risks.risk: The attachments may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo showing all attachments included, including the nozzle and any other accessories.

proof_requests: Close-up of the rating plate on the hairdryer or stand showing the model and pin code.
A video showing the unit powered on and functioning.
A close-up photo of the power cord and plug, confirming it is 220V and intact.
A photo showing all attachments included, including the nozzle and any other accessories.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
